_comment: Sound pipeline config (tools/sound/fabricsfx.py). One entry per material category the runtime knows (FabricSound.Material). 'source' is a file in the source folder; 'derive' builds a material from another one's cleaned audio with SoX effects. Every number here is a starting point the analysis may override where marked 'auto'.

loudness._comment: Integrated loudness targets (LUFS) per layer. The runtime only scales these down, so they set the mix between layers and materials.

flag._source: 60 s of a heavy flag in steady wind (replaced Flag.wav, which sounded thin and unnatural in-game). Long grains and a long loop keep its flapping rhythm intact; few extra snaps, it has its own.

bunting._comment: Small pennants on a string: the flag recording sped up (shorter cloth flutters faster and higher), thinned, with less body.
